claim: The SARVA homepage describes the South African Climate Risk Tool as using NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 projections, bias-corrected and statistically downscaled to approximately 25 km, with spatial information at local-municipality level. This supports broad climate screening, not a claim about street-level heat exposure or a particular corridor.

coverage.place_label: South Africa; tool overview describes local-municipality-level information

method.description: Summary of SARVA's public overview page; the underlying raster/data service was not retrieved or independently inspected.
method.model_or_protocol_version: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 (as described; exact product version not captured)

uncertainty.description: The overview provides an approximate spatial resolution but does not by itself establish the selected scenario, current dataset release, or uncertainty values for a particular place and period.

review.rationale: Initial public-source summary; the underlying tool and local suitability have not been independently reviewed.

limitations: Approximately 25 km resolution is not exact 25,000-metre precision; the qualifier must remain visible.
Municipal-scale climate projections must not be downscaled or represented as street-level observations without additional validated data and methods.
The overview is a discovery source, not evidence that a specific shaded-route intervention will improve measured heat exposure.
